## DotOS v0.2.1

Daily-wear polish from real-world feedback, on top of v0.2.0.

### Fixes & changes
- **Gentler alarm & calls** — the alarm/timer chime is now a soft rising bell
  phrase with a per-note envelope and a slow crescendo (coaxes you awake rather
  than jolting); the alarm and incoming-call haptics use a soft "wake" tap.
- **Incoming call: Hang up** — the call banner now has a **Hang up** button next
  to **Mute**. On iOS it declines the call (ANCS); on Android it silences the
  ring for this call.
- **Alarm/timer setup no longer interrupted** — setting an alarm or timer no
  longer dims out or bounces back to the clock mid-edit.
- **Offense double opt-in** — entering Offense from the Apps menu now requires
  the consent card **and** the PIN; the persistent red Offense border was
  removed.
- **Facewatch accents** — dropped the plain White accent; added **Cyan** and a
  vivid **Pip-Boy green**.
- **Health** — removed the always-blank Stress row (Health Connect carries no
  stress data), re-spaced the remaining rows.

### Flashing
Open **`DotOS-v0.2.1-flasher.html`** below in Chrome or Edge, plug the watch in
over USB-C, and click **Flash**. To keep your settings across the update, flash
**without** erasing the NVS partition.
